description: REGRESSION: many tool calls in one assistant turn. Every call must come back paired with its tool_call_id — an unpaired one produced the 'did not have response messages' 400 that persisted across retries.
setup: for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do printf 'export const value%s = %s;\n' "$i" "$i" > "mod$i.js"; done
prompt: Read all eight mod*.js files and tell me the sum of the values they export. Read them in parallel.
